2610.06778.title: IdeaLens: Detecting AI Ideas in Long-form Writing
2610.06778.paper_summary: While modern AI detectors identify who wrote the words, emerging policies on AI use increasingly hinge on a different question: who came up with the ideas? We introduce IdeaLens, a detector that identifies whether a document's ideas came from a human or AI (idea provenance), regardless of who wrote its words. To focus IdeaLens on ideas rather than prose, we represent documents as outlines: lists of items that each pair a discourse role with a brief, paraphrased description of the content, minimizing word-level overlap with the raw text. We train IdeaLens on 1M FineWeb documents with silver labels from Pangram, a prose provenance detector. Since the outlines are largely stripped of surface-level information, the labels must be fit mainly through the ideas. In a controlled study, IdeaLens's AI flag rate drops from 95% to 7% as models write from increasingly detailed human plans, while Pangram 4 still flags 92%; from AI-derived plans, IdeaLens stays above 96%. Conversely, on a new dataset of 50 stories that human authors wrote from AI-generated plans, IdeaLens flags 68% of the stories as AI, compared to 8% for Pangram 4. On a comprehensive suite of 19 existing detection benchmarks, we show that IdeaLens maintains strong detection rates at low false positive rates, suggesting that ideas themselves provide a powerful discriminative signal, and its performance holds across domains, formats, and languages. Finally, we examine 90K predictions from IdeaLens to characterize systematic differences between human and AI ideation. We release our models and labeled datasets to facilitate future research on idea provenance detection.
2610.06778.paper_summary_zh: 雖然現代的 AI 檢測器能識別誰寫了這些文字，但新興的 AI 使用政策越來越依賴於另一個問題：誰想出了這些想法？我們介紹 IdeaLens，一個檢測器，用於識別一份文件的想法是來自人類還是 AI（想法來源），無論是誰寫下了這些文字。為了使 IdeaLens 專注於想法而非文辭，我們將文件表示為大綱：項目的列表，每個項目將話語角色與內容的簡要改述描述配對，最小化與原始文本的字詞重疊。我們在 1M FineWeb 文件上訓練 IdeaLens，這些文件的標籤來自 Pangram，一個文辭來源檢測器。由於這些大綱在很大程度上剝離了表面信息，標籤必須主要通過想法來適配。在一項受控研究中，IdeaLens 的 AI 標記率從 95% 下降到 7%，因為模型根據越來越詳細的人類計劃進行寫作，而 Pangram 4 仍然標記 92%；對於 AI 生成的計劃，IdeaLens 保持在 96% 以上。相反，在一個新的數據集上，這 50 個故事是人類作者根據 AI 生成的計劃寫的，IdeaLens 將 68% 的故事標記為 AI，而 Pangram 4 只有 8%。在一套全面的 19 個現有檢測基準中，我們顯示 IdeaLens 在低假陽性率下保持強大的檢測率，這表明想法本身提供了一個強大的區分信號，其性能在不同領域、格式和語言中保持穩定。最後，我們檢查了 IdeaLens 的 90K 預測，以描述人類和 AI 構思之間的系統性差異。我們釋出我們的模型和標記數據集，以促進未來對想法來源檢測的研究。
